def fn(t0, t1, t2, k, lst, dct):
    idx1 = torch.tensor([0, 1], device=t0.device)
    t0.index_fill_(1, idx1, k)
    v2 = t1.unfold(1, 1, 3)
    t2[t2 > -2] = k
    v2.clamp_(-4, 3)
    t1[0::2, :, :] = k
    v2.transpose_(3, 1)
